selection_rule: On the calibration split only, keep cells whose edit rate is in (0, 0.95] and whose mean gold-rank increase is positive. Choose the largest mean rank increase, breaking ties toward smaller K and then smaller delta. Fit one gold-logit penalty to that cell's mean gold-probability drop. Freeze the cell only if its rank increase exceeds the penalty's rank increase by min_rank_separation. Do not read FE, GSM8K, or any other test metric before writing the lock.

fe_noninferiority.note: Register margin from multi-seed ASU and ASU+Anchor reruns before reading demotion test metrics.
